The /api context path applies only to the main server and management base-path defaults to empty, so /actuator/health/{liveness,readiness} on 8080 (deployment lines 35-52) returns 200.

application.yml line 14 sets management.server.port: -1, which ManagementPortType.get maps to DISABLED, so no actuator endpoints are served over HTTP on any port. k8s/deployment.yaml lines 30-43 probe /actuator/health/readiness and /actuator/health/liveness on named port http (8080), where the main app answers 404; add-additional-paths is not set, so /livez and /readyz do not exist either.
